headline: Shipping-label management in the admin console
summary: The admin console gains shipping-label tools. On an order, void a purchased label — with a reason — when it needs reprinting, alongside the existing mark-as-used action. A new Shipping labels section adds cross-order visibility: a status-filtered list, the mint queue of labels awaiting a broker, and a broker-spend report that totals label costs by carrier and currency over a date range. This is bookkeeping and reporting only — nothing in the storefront, cart, or checkout changes.

items.title: Void a shipping label from the order
items.body: Each purchased label on an order now offers a Void action with a reason, for when a label is reprinted at a different weight or carrier. Voiding is refused once a label has been used or already voided, or once it is past the carrier's void window.

items.title: Shipping labels admin section
items.body: A new Shipping labels section gives cross-order visibility: a status-filtered label list, the mint queue of labels awaiting a broker, and a broker-spend report totalling label cost grouped by carrier and currency over a date range.
